wish: someone should make a tool that plans seating charts
spec:
Plans who sits where: add guests and tables, mark pairs who must sit apart, and it seats everyone at different tables for each pair, adding tables when needed.
Tap a guest then a seat (or drag on desktop) to place or swap; tap a seated guest to move, unseat or remove them; clashes show in red; Print gives a clean chart.
It does not draw room floor plans, handle meal choices, or share the chart; everything stays in this browser.
notes: Tap-to-place on phones, HTML5 drag on desktop. Seat everyone backtracks over keep-apart pairs and adds tables only when capacity or a pair requires it.
